```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```


# Load data

```{r}
# LGA data
lga_all <- st_read("data/lga/LGA_POLYGON.shp", quiet = TRUE) |>
  select(LGA_CODE, LGA_NAME)

crs_vic <- st_crs(lga_all)
```


```{r}
# Vicmap Planning zones: PPRZ (recreation) and PCRZ (conservation)
zones <- st_read("data/vicmap_data/gda2020_vicgrid/esrishape/whole_of_dataset/victoria/VMPLAN/PLAN_ZONE.shp") |>
    filter(ZONE_CODE %in% c("PPRZ", "PCRZ")) |>
    st_transform(crs_vic) |>
    st_make_valid()

st_write(zones, "data/plan_zone_pprz_pcrz.gpkg")
```

```{r}
# ABS Mesh Blocks 2021 for Victoria
mb <- st_read("data/MB_2021_AUST_SHP_GDA2020/MB_2021_AUST_GDA2020.shp") |>
    filter(STE_CODE21 == "2") |>
    st_transform(crs_vic)

# Census 2021 Mesh Block counts for Victoria
mb_counts <- map_dfr(
  c("Table 2", "Table 2.1"),
  \(s) read_excel(
    "data/Mesh Block Counts, 2021.xlsx",
    sheet = s,
    skip = 6,
    col_types = "text"
  )
) |>
  filter(str_detect(MB_CODE_2021, "^\\d{11}$")) |>
  transmute(
    MB_CODE21 = MB_CODE_2021,
    dwellings = as.numeric(Dwelling),
    persons = as.numeric(Person)
  )
```
